--- pipe_join_cross_unnest.sql
FROM LeftTable
|> CROSS JOIN UNNEST([1, 2]) AS value

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  15,
        Op:    "CROSS JOIN",
        Right: &ast.Unnest{
          Unnest: 29,
          Rparen: 42,
          Expr:   &ast.ArrayLiteral{
            Array:  -1,
            Lbrack: 36,
            Rbrack: 41,
            Values: []ast.Expr{
              &ast.IntLiteral{
                ValuePos: 37,
                ValueEnd: 38,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "1",
              },
              &ast.IntLiteral{
                ValuePos: 40,
                ValueEnd: 41,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "2",
              },
            },
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    44,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 47,
              NameEnd: 52,
              Name:    "value",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable |> CROSS JOIN UNNEST([1, 2]) AS value
